summary: Hiker near the Chief Ouray Mine above Ouray became off-trail and disoriented in the Cascade Falls drainage. OMRT gave remote guidance by phone, then a three-person hasty team reached the man after an hour.
notes: Phone-guided attempt failed; hasty team deployed.
